$comment: Every direct dependency, with why we need it (ADR 0006). `bun run check` fails if package.json has a package that isn't listed here, or this lists one package.json doesn't have. `bun run deps:health` runs ADR 0006's health checks on added or changed packages; `exceptions` allows a named failing check (scorecard, recent-release, maintainers, install-scripts, license) and says why. `scorecardRepo` names where the Scorecard service files a renamed repo; it counts only if GitHub says it's the same repo the package's provenance was built from. Changing this file needs a code owner's approval.

lucide-react.reason: Icons (ADR 0020): line icons on one grid, drawn by the Icon component in packages/ui, the only file that imports it. Only the icons we use ship.

exceptions.maintainers: One npm maintainer (the Lucide lead). Pinned exactly, 7-day release age, and each upgrade reviewed (ADR 0020).

react.reason: The UI layer (ADR 0018). Ships to users, in a file of its own that browsers keep for a year.

react-dom.reason: Renders React into the page (ADR 0018). Ships with react, in the same cached file.

@playwright/test.reason: E2E tests of the built site in a real browser (ADR 0003, 0004).

@types/bun.reason: Types for bun:test and Bun's APIs, pinned to the packageManager Bun version.

exceptions.maintainers: One npm maintainer: the DefinitelyTyped publishing account. Types only, never runs.

@types/node.reason: Types for the node: modules the check scripts use.

exceptions.maintainers: One npm maintainer: the DefinitelyTyped publishing account. Types only, never runs.

typescript.reason: Type checking; pinned to 6.x for typescript-eslint (ADR 0007).

knip.reason: Finds unused files, exports and dependencies, and dependencies used but not declared. Agents leave all four behind.

exceptions.maintainers: One npm maintainer (webpro). Dev-only, no install scripts, ISC.
exceptions.scorecard: deps.dev publishes no OpenSSF Scorecard for webpro-nl/knip. Dev-only, no install scripts, actively released.

happy-dom.reason: Simulated DOM for the tests in apps/web/test/dom (ADR 0003). Only runs our own built page and bundle; file and network loading stay disabled.

exceptions.maintainers: One npm maintainer (davidortner). Dev-only, no install scripts, MIT; accepted in ADR 0003.

turbo.reason: Runs each workspace's tasks, and on PRs only the workspaces a change affects (ADR 0016). Dev-only, never ships; no remote cache, telemetry off.

exceptions.scorecard: deps.dev publishes no OpenSSF Scorecard for vercel/turborepo. Released by Vercel with npm provenance attestations; dev-only, no install scripts, MIT. Approved with ADR 0016.

@types/react.reason: Types for React (ADR 0018). Types only, never runs.

exceptions.maintainers: One npm maintainer: the DefinitelyTyped publishing account. Types only, never runs.

@types/react-dom.reason: Types for React DOM (ADR 0018). Types only, never runs.

exceptions.maintainers: One npm maintainer: the DefinitelyTyped publishing account. Types only, never runs.

eslint-plugin-react-hooks.reason: The rules of hooks, as lint errors (ADR 0018). 5.2.0: no dependencies, unlike 7.x (Babel and 40-odd packages).

notes: ESLint and typescript-eslint together add about 90 packages, over ADR 0006's warning level of 20. Accepted in ADR 0007: type-aware linting is the main deterministic guard against bad agent code. The app itself has no runtime dependencies (ADR 0005).
